messages.subject: Errors with dlm code examples
parts:
Hello,

I've tried to run examples 3 and 4 (which contain simulated datasets) from:
http://www.math.ntnu.no/inla/r-inla.org/papers/DLM_examples_11112010.R

I get the following error:

Error in inla(formula, data = data.frame(i, weight0, j, weight1, l, weight2,  :
  f(o). Covariate does not match 'values' 2 times. Indexes for mismatch:101 200. This is not what you want. Use NA values in the covariate!

I had a look to other posts that mention similar error, it seems to be related to a wrong length of indices that are passed to inla program, but i didn't find out what's going wrong in these examples..
Any idea?

Thank you very much in advance
Emmanuel
